zh-CN.title: 网页版广场回顶按钮修复
items: 广场下滑后会稳定显示圆形回到顶部按钮
按钮与箭头不再被发言列表或底部导航遮挡

en.title: Fixed the Square back-to-top control on web
items: The circular back-to-top button now remains visible after scrolling through Square
The button and arrow are no longer clipped by the feed or covered by bottom navigation
